title: Atomic Plan
statement: Implement `solve(destination)`. Return `{"tmp": ..., "final": destination}`. `tmp` is the destination plus the suffix `.tmp` in the same directory. This is the plan for writing beside the target and then replacing it. Do not invent a different directory.
hints: Do not strip an existing suffix before adding .tmp. Add it at the end.
The directory stays whatever the destination already had.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: An atomic replace writes a complete temp file next to the target, then os.

editorial: An atomic replace writes a complete temp file next to the target, then os.replace swaps the name. The temp name has to be on the same filesystem, which a same-directory suffix guarantees in this lexical plan. A temp directory on another drive would make the replace a copy.
